intro: 1 kiwi gives about 45 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from natural sugar. It's one of the lightest fruits per piece.

breakdown.part: A bit of protein and fat

diet: Yes. Kiwi is small, light in calories and has fibre. Easy to bring to the office as a snack. It doesn't 'burn fat', but it's a good snack choice compared to kuih or biscuits.
tips: Cut in half and eat with a spoon. Easy at the office.
Keep 2 to 3 kiwis in your work bag as an emergency snack.
Pair with a boiled egg or a small handful of nuts to feel fuller.

swap.name: Jambu batu (guava), 1/2 fruit
swap.why: Local fruit, cheaper, almost the same calories and high in fibre.

faq.a: Yes. Wash well and rub off the fuzz. Gold kiwi skin is smoother and easier to eat.

faq.q: What's the difference between green and gold kiwi?
faq.a: Green kiwi is more sour. Gold kiwi is sweeter and less fuzzy. Calories are almost the same.

faq.q: Does kiwi help with bowel movements?
faq.a: Kiwi has fibre and water, and many people find it helps. But everyone is different. Drinking enough water and eating vegetables also matter.
